description: This file implements secure system call wrappers, including functions for executing commands, handling pipes, redirections, and process management, with support for eval expressions and subshells. It also provides popen and pclose wrappers with thread safety and legacy API compatibility.

methods.name: new_task
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new task structure for command parsing.

methods.name: free_fd_ops
methods.description: Frees linked list of file descriptor operations associated with a task.

methods.name: free_task
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a task structure and its components.

methods.name: free_task_list
methods.description: Recursively frees a list of tasks and their subshells.

methods.name: fd_ops_addopen
methods.description: Adds an open file descriptor operation to a task.

methods.name: fd_ops_addclose
methods.description: Adds a close file descriptor operation to a task.

methods.name: fd_ops_adddup2
methods.description: Adds a dup2 file descriptor operation to a task.

methods.name: apply_fd_ops
methods.description: Applies all file descriptor operations associated with a task.

methods.name: _vsnprintf
methods.description: Custom vsnprintf implementation to process format strings and arguments.

methods.name: command_parser
methods.description: Parses command strings into task structures, supporting subshells, redirections, and eval expressions.

methods.name: execute_task
methods.description: Executes a single task, handling forking, process execution, and subshells.

methods.name: execute_task_list
methods.description: Executes a list of tasks with support for pipes, logical AND/OR, and background execution.

methods.name: v_secure_system_internal
methods.description: Parses command format and returns a list of tasks for execution.

methods.name: v_secure_system
methods.description: Main function to execute a command string securely, managing process creation and waiting.

methods.name: v_secure_pclose
methods.description: Closes a FILE stream opened by v_secure_popen, waits for process termination.

methods.name: v_secure_popen_internal
methods.description: Creates a pipe and forks a process to execute command, returning FILE pointer for reading or writing.

methods.name: v_secure_popen
methods.description: Wrapper for v_secure_popen_internal, providing variadic interface.

methods.name: contains_secure_separator
methods.description: Stub function for checking secure separators in strings, returns -1.

methods.name: secure_system_call_p
methods.description: Executes a command with argument array, waits for completion, returns exit status.

methods.name: secure_system_call_vp
methods.description: Executes a command with variadic arguments, constructs argument array, and calls secure_system_call_p.
